artifacts.notes: The press route https://press.vatican.va/archive/hist_councils/ii_vatican_council/documents/vat-ii_decree_19651028_perfectae-caritatis_en.html and content-delivery route https://www.vatican.va/content/dam/wss/archive/hist_councils/ii_vatican_council/documents/vat-ii_decree_19651028_perfectae-caritatis_en.html returned byte-identical 36410-byte responses with this SHA-256 on 2026-07-24; the aliases are not duplicated. The response contains the complete numbered English body and its single Ambrose note but no promulgation or subscription block. Delivered defects include article 1's «ministry-the building»; article 2's malformed list marker «e )»; article 11's missing punctuation after «not Religious institutes» and «everywhere in and»; article 13's missing separator between Matthew 25:34-46 and James 2:15-16; article 15's «cf.Rom.» and «to-the diversity»; and article 19's «have recently established» with «been» omitted. This records known source-local defects without claiming an exhaustive diplomatic collation. Exact bytes are identified but not retained.

edition.notes: A dated Vatican delivery state of an unnamed English translation. The registered response contains the complete numbered body, articles 1-25, and its single source note. Its visible heading identifies Paul VI and the 28 October 1965 proclamation, but the response omits the promulgation formula, date and subscription line, conciliar subscriptions, and notarial attestations.

passages.context: The complete English article was inspected for renewal's governing principles: the Gospel as highest rule, return to founders' spirit and aims and sound traditions, adaptation to changed circumstances and present need, and spiritual renewal as the prerequisite without which adaptation is ineffectual.
passages.notes: The publication's «proper charism» is a bounded editorial shorthand for the founder's spirit, special aims, and sound traditions. The article does not itself prove later causal outcomes, and its Scripture and other cross-references remain source-of-source leads.

passages.context: The complete English range was inspected for the authorized breadth and governance of adaptation: ways of living, praying, working, and governing; revised constitutions, directories, custom books, prayers, and ceremonies; suppression of obsolete laws; member cooperation; competent authority; and prudent experimentation.
passages.notes: The range establishes an official season of revision but does not establish every later implementation measure, institute decision, or causal outcome. Ecclesiae Sanctae remains a separate act requiring its own witness and binding.
